summary: Phase K squad export implementation has critical backend authorization, schema, and integration blockers. Frontend token source and UI integration are incomplete. Test coverage claims are unsubstantiated. All 13 plan items are marked done but code does not match verification criteria.

deduplicatedFindings.title: Internal identity mismatch: JWT subject does not resolve to User.id
deduplicatedFindings.description: Controller decorator @CurrentUser('sub') supplies the JWT payload object; CurrentUser ignores its selector and returns the full payload. The service compares this object against AuctionRoom.hostId (UUID) and filters TeamOwner.userId by it. Cognito's 'sub' maps to UserIdentity.subject, not the internal User.id used for ownership. Authorization will fail because the value type is wrong.
deduplicatedFindings.remedy: Resolve UserIdentity.subject to User.id at the authentication boundary. Pass the internal userId to authorization, not the JWT payload.

deduplicatedFindings.title: Invalid Prisma query: references nonexistent schema fields
deduplicatedFindings.description: PlayerAcquisition sort uses 'createdAt' but schema defines 'settledAt'; no createdAt exists. Owner select references User.displayName but displayName is on UserProfile, not User. Prisma rejects the query before execution (500 error). Code uses `any` casts to suppress TypeScript errors, hiding the schema mismatches.
deduplicatedFindings.remedy: Use 'settledAt' for sort order. Join UserProfile to access displayName. Remove `any` casts; regenerate Prisma client and add proper DTO types.

deduplicatedFindings.title: Authorization and data loading are split across multiple calls with time-of-check-to-time-of-use gap
deduplicatedFindings.description: Controller calls verifyExportAuthorization for filename metadata. Export methods (CSV/XLSX) call it again. If authorization state changes between calls (team owner released), filename reflects full scope while export is filtered to empty, creating asymmetry. Additionally, authorization occurs outside the transaction, permitting released-ownership to briefly export before error.
deduplicatedFindings.remedy: Consolidate to single-call pattern: authorize in controller, pass authorizedTeamId to export methods, fetch data once in repeatable-read transaction.

deduplicatedFindings.title: Missing purse, category, and compliance data for exports
deduplicatedFindings.description: Response omits AuctionTeam.purseInitialMinor and category-spend breakdown. Query exports global Player.category instead of auction-specific AuctionPlayer.category. Unvalidated squads are marked compliant; SquadValidation.valid result is ignored.
deduplicatedFindings.remedy: Add purseInitialMinor and category spend to export DTO. Use AuctionPlayer.category for query. Use stored SquadValidation.valid; represent unvalidated squads explicitly.

deduplicatedFindings.title: CSV/XLSX schemas diverge; formula protection incomplete
deduplicatedFindings.description: Papa Parse CSV derives headers from camelCase object keys; XLSX uses display labels. Workbook sheet is 'Squad' not 'Squad Export'. Team and player names are escaped, but owner display names are joined directly to CSV cells. User-controlled display names with formula prefixes (=, +, -, @) remain executable.
deduplicatedFindings.remedy: Generate both CSV and XLSX from one column definition. Apply escapeFormulaInjection to all string cells, including owner display names and player roles.

deduplicatedFindings.title: Route versioning doubled; UUID validation missing
deduplicatedFindings.description: URI versioning adds /v1; controller hard-codes 'v1/auctions', producing doubled prefix. Browser calls /api/v1 but route is under /api/v1/v1. auctionId bypasses Zod validation; invalid UUIDs become 500 errors.
deduplicatedFindings.remedy: Use version-neutral controller path. Validate auctionId against Zod UUID schema at boundary.

deduplicatedFindings.title: Export UI unmounted; frontend reads wrong token store
deduplicatedFindings.description: No production page renders SquadTab or ExportButton; components exist only in feature files. useSquadExport reads localStorage.getItem('token') but sign-in stores token in module memory via setAuthToken. Signed-in users receive 'Authentication required' error.
deduplicatedFindings.remedy: Mount ExportButton in real squad view. Reuse getAuthToken() or authenticated API client instead of localStorage.

deduplicatedFindings.title: Filename mismatch: server and client generate independently
deduplicatedFindings.description: useSquadExport and SquadExportService both implement sanitizeFilename and generateFilename. If truncation rules or timestamp formats diverge, predicted and actual filenames mismatch. Server filename is not conveyed to client via Content-Disposition header.
deduplicatedFindings.remedy: Return server-generated filename in Content-Disposition header. Client parses and uses authoritative value.

deduplicatedFindings.title: Missing success state and mobile touch-target sizing
deduplicatedFindings.description: Hook exposes no success state. Component shows no confirmation after download. Button sizing (text-sm py-2) produces ~36 px instead of required 44 px mobile touch target.
deduplicatedFindings.remedy: Add success state to hook and display in component. Add min-h-[44px] and test responsive layout at 375, 768, 1024, 1440 px.

deduplicatedFindings.title: Shared contracts package unlinked; test resolution fails
deduplicatedFindings.description: @uth/contracts is imported by both apps but not declared in package.json. No workspace link exists. Vitest configurations lack alias. Both test runners fail during collection: 'Failed to resolve import @uth/contracts'. Production TypeScript also uses `any` for Prisma, ExcelJS, and Papa Parse.
deduplicatedFindings.remedy: Add '@uth/contracts: workspace:*' to both apps' package.json. Update Vitest config aliases. Install type declarations (papaparse, exceljs). Remove `any` escapes.

deduplicatedFindings.title: Test coverage claims unsubstantiated: zero tests execute
deduplicatedFindings.description: Plan claims 45+ tests with >85% coverage. All targeted suites (service, controller, hook, component) collect zero tests because contract resolution fails. Backend mocks describe the pre-fix service shape. XLSX test checks only ZIP signature; direct controller calls do not exercise guard, routing, or mobile behavior.
deduplicatedFindings.remedy: Fix contract resolution (item 10). Rewrite tests with typed payloads, real Vitest globals, actual Prisma mocks. Add HTTP layer, browser download, and responsive tests. Publish measured coverage >85%.

deduplicatedFindings.title: TypeScript escapes mask type errors; strict mode violated
deduplicatedFindings.description: Production export code uses @ts-ignore and multiple explicit `any` values for Prisma, ExcelJS, and Papa Parse. API typecheck reports missing types on auctionRoom, teamOwner, $transaction.
deduplicatedFindings.remedy: Regenerate Prisma client. Install type declarations. Use Prisma.*GetPayload for payload types. Remove all @ts-ignore and `any` escapes.

deduplicatedFindings.title: Compliance status uses unnecessary object serialization
deduplicatedFindings.description: getSquadExportData constructs ComplianceStatusDetail object, then immediately converts to string via formatComplianceStatusString. Structured object is internal-only; no benefit for file consumers.
deduplicatedFindings.remedy: Format compliance as string upfront in data layer; skip intermediate object construction.

uncheckedPlanItems.title: Create shared export contract
uncheckedPlanItems.reason: Contract created but not integrated into workspace dependencies; test resolution fails.

uncheckedPlanItems.title: Create SquadExportService
uncheckedPlanItems.reason: Service created but uses `any` escapes; Prisma query invalid against canonical schema; schema mismatches on createdAt, displayName, category.

uncheckedPlanItems.title: Add export endpoint
uncheckedPlanItems.reason: Endpoint added but route versioning doubled; UUID validation missing; no integration with real auth/token flow.

uncheckedPlanItems.title: Write backend tests
uncheckedPlanItems.reason: Tests declared but non-executing due to contract resolution failure. No measured coverage provided.

uncheckedPlanItems.title: Integrate ExportButton into squad view
uncheckedPlanItems.reason: Component not mounted in production; exists only in feature files.

uncheckedPlanItems.title: Run full monorepo build and test suite
uncheckedPlanItems.reason: Build and typecheck not actually executed; would catch contract, schema, and import resolution errors.

gpt.keyProblems: Authenticated requests cannot resolve to internal user IDs; Prisma query contains nonexistent fields; route versioning doubled; authenticated frontend flow not mounted; test suites non-executing; multiple type escapes mask errors.

fable.keyProblems: Authorization redundancy between controller and service; filename generation duplicated across client/server; compliance object serialization unnecessary.

overallVerdictReasoning: Implementation does not meet shipping criteria. Blocking issues span authorization identity, database schema mismatches, frontend token source, component mounting, and test infrastructure. Plan checklist marks all items complete but verification criteria were not met: build/typecheck not run, contract not integrated, service uses invalid queries, frontend not wired to production, tests non-executing. These are not minor gaps; they prevent the feature from functioning. Changes required before review.
